senses.example: After the hurricane there was a severe regional shortage of plywood, especially exterior plywood.

senses.definition: A specific grade or type of this construction material.
senses.example: We stock exterior plywoods, interior plywoods, and furniture plywoods.

senses.definition: To fit or block up with plywood.
A model railroad layout that lacks scenery, being mostly just trackwork on a bare plywood (or other benchwork top like styrofoam or OSB)
Resembling or characteristic of plywood.
Pilsen (a city in the Czech Republic).
